columns.name: plan_format
columns.reason: Format of the plan set is fixed when the application is submitted.

columns.name: appeal_hearings_scheduled
columns.reason: Appeals are only scheduled after a decision, and essentially only after a rejection.

columns.name: lot_orientation
columns.reason: Static parcel geometry attribute known before submission.

columns.name: zoning_district
columns.reason: Standing parcel zoning designation, on file before the application.

columns.name: streetlight_zone
columns.reason: Static municipal service-area geography attached to the parcel.

columns.name: leaf_collection_zone
columns.reason: Static municipal service-area geography attached to the parcel.

columns.name: site_access_code
columns.reason: Site characteristic recorded with the application at intake.

columns.name: grading_permit_class
columns.reason: Permit classification assigned from the application at intake.

columns.name: reviewer_egress_deficiency
columns.reason: A plan-review finding produced during adjudication that is itself a stated ground for rejection.

columns.name: corner_lot_flag
columns.reason: Static parcel geometry attribute known before submission.

columns.name: septic_class
columns.reason: Standing site/servicing attribute of the parcel.

columns.name: applicant_type
columns.reason: Supplied by the applicant on the submitted application.

columns.name: days_to_final_disposition
columns.reason: Measured from submission to the final decision, so it only exists once the outcome is known.

columns.name: stormwater_tier
columns.reason: Regulatory tier derived from standing site/parcel characteristics.

columns.name: fee_schedule_ver
columns.reason: The fee schedule in force at submission is fixed at intake.

columns.name: parcel_shape_code
columns.reason: Static parcel geometry attribute from the cadastre.

columns.name: historic_overlay
columns.reason: Standing zoning overlay recorded against the parcel.

columns.name: fee_waiver_code
columns.reason: Waiver category is an intake/fee-assessment attribute, not a review finding or decision rationale.

columns.name: recycling_route
columns.reason: Static municipal service-route geography attached to the parcel.

columns.name: council_district
columns.reason: Static political geography of the parcel.

columns.name: frontage_class
columns.reason: Static parcel frontage characteristic.

columns.name: sidewalk_class
columns.reason: Existing streetscape condition at the site, known before submission.

columns.name: curb_cut_code
columns.reason: Existing site access condition recorded with the parcel/application.

columns.name: reviewer_setback_deficiency
columns.reason: A plan-review finding produced during adjudication that is itself a stated ground for rejection.

columns.name: plan_sheet_count
columns.reason: Counted from the plan set as submitted, so it exists at intake.

columns.name: parcel_area_m2
columns.reason: Static cadastral measurement of the parcel.

columns.name: ward_id
columns.reason: Static political geography of the parcel.

columns.name: post_decision_correspondence
columns.reason: By definition recorded after the decision is issued.

columns.name: notary_office
columns.reason: Notarisation happens before the application is filed.

columns.name: flood_zone_code
columns.reason: Published flood-map designation for the parcel, standing before submission.

columns.name: refuse_route
columns.reason: Static municipal service-route geography attached to the parcel.

columns.name: prior_approvals_5yr
columns.reason: Historical count over prior closed permits, computable as of the submission date.

columns.name: utility_provider
columns.reason: Standing servicing attribute of the parcel.

columns.name: resubmission_count
columns.reason: Accumulates through the review cycle in response to deficiency notices and is only final at disposition.

columns.name: assessor_roll_class
columns.reason: Standing tax-roll classification of the property.

columns.name: easement_code
columns.reason: Recorded encumbrance on title, standing before submission.

columns.name: submission_channel
columns.reason: Determined by how the application was filed, fixed at intake.

columns.name: school_district
columns.reason: Static administrative geography of the parcel.

columns.name: survey_vendor
columns.reason: The survey is prepared and attributed before the application is filed.

columns.name: sewer_district
columns.reason: Static servicing geography of the parcel.

columns.name: alley_access_flag
columns.reason: Static parcel access characteristic.

columns.name: e_filing_ver
columns.reason: The filing-system version used is fixed at the moment of submission.

columns.name: intake_clerk_id
columns.reason: Assigned when the application is received, before review.

columns.name: tree_ordinance_zone
columns.reason: Standing ordinance geography attached to the parcel.

columns.name: designer_experience_yrs
columns.reason: Attribute of the design professional named on the submitted application.

columns.name: snow_route_class
columns.reason: Static municipal service-route geography attached to the parcel.
